messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2912345999 - Elevated 5xx on hosted-prod inference (kv-cache eviction storm). Paging @amanda @raj. Detected 2026-02-12T14:03:10Z. Severity: Sev2. Dash: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/xyz/errors | logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/q=2912345999
amanda: Ack - looking. Prioritizing smoke checks and log tail. Will update in 4.
raj: I'm here - suggest disabling kv-cache on pool and tighten batch window. Prep commands...
amanda: Initial logs show repeated decode OOMs during concurrent cache misses. Sample:
```
2026-02-12T14:02:58Z ERROR runtime/decoder.go:512 decode: alloc failed model=redwood-large-quant256 err=oom
```
raj: Mitigation commands:
```
redwoodctl runtime update --pool=hosted-prod --set=kvcache.enabled=false --note="mitigation: eviction storm"
redwoodctl rollout restart --pool=hosted-prod
```
amanda: Applied to shard-1 at 14:05 UTC. Errors dropped from ~38% -> 6% on that shard. Rolling remainder.
devon: Noted customer routing risk - preferring dedicated variants for high-SLA customers while we investigate.
natalie: Customer impact tracker: 9 customers hit timeouts 14:01-14:09 UTC. Highlighted cust-209, cust-88. Opening CS cases.
eva-ops: Created support tickets 80122, 80123; emailing account teams.
raj: Long-term hypothesis: quantization memory layout + simultaneous miss storm causes decoder alloc spikes and OOM. Repro in staging underway.
amanda: Repro config: model=redwood-large-quant256 qflag=int8-v3 load=burst 2k rps cold prefixes -> reproduces eviction/OOM.
raj: Immediate next steps: 1) schedule postmortem; 2) create remediation epic; 3) assign action owners.
amanda: Postmortem scheduled 2026-02-13 15:00 UTC. Invite to eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, eng-oncall.
devon: Adding customer outreach and billing impact to agenda.
natalie: I'll compile affected request ids and SLA exposure for CS.
eva-ops: Drafting customer note and compensation proposal.
sre-bot: Created ticket RWD-INC-2026-2912345999 in tracker -> https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE/RWD-INC-2026-2912345999
raj: Draft AI list:
- AI-1: Run heap and jemalloc profiling during decode on qconfig int8-v3 (owner: amanda) - due 2026-02-17
- AI-2: Add kv-cache overload guard (max concurrent in-flight fetches + exponential backoff) (owner: raj) - due 2026-02-19
- AI-3: Expand quantization QA to include cold-prefix patterns and high concurrency (owner: eng-ml - devon) - due 2026-02-22
- AI-4: Update runbook with explicit mitigation steps and rollback commands (owner: amanda) - due 2026-02-14
- AI-5: Staging e2e harness for batching+kv depletion scenarios (owner: natalie) - due 2026-02-18
- AI-6: Customer outreach & compensation recommendation (owner: eva-ops) - due 2026-02-16
- AI-7: Explore auto-fallback to float model variants under high kv-errors (owner: eng-runtime team) - due 2026-02-23

amanda: Pushed runbook changes: https://git.redwood/rw/runtime-runbook/pull/468 - please review.
devon: I'll wire test failures into CI and ping eng-ml.
natalie: CS notified cust-209 and cust-88; awaiting responses. Support tickets: 80122, 80123.
eva-ops: Watchlist created; scheduled 24h check-ins.
raj: Note for postmortem: disabling kv-cache resolved errors quickly but increased token CPU cost ~3.8%. Add cost/reliability tradeoff to action items.
amanda: We need richer telemetry: per-key eviction counters, decoder alloc histograms at model-level.
devon: Created remediation epic RWD-EP-2026-460 and linked the AI tickets.
sre-bot: Resolving pager at 2026-02-12T14:13:45Z. Follow-ups in RWD-INC-2026-2912345999 and epic RWD-EP-2026-460.
